title: CIVIL WAR & THE SON OF PERDITION

sense.text:
“The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom”. Edom is the so-called white man.

“Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.” Somebody is going to rise up and say, let us fight against her. The her here is America and the land of Israel: that is the main Edom being spoken of. Somebody is going to rise up and say, let us fight against America and Israel.

“Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen”: the land of Israel is small, a small little land amongst all them Arabs, as anyone can see when they look on the map.

“thou art greatly despised.” The nations will hate America, and the nations will hate the Israelis. That is Bible prophecy.

“The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock”: that is the Caucasians.

“whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?” For them to say that, they have to have power. Only one who has power can say, who can bring me down to the ground?

precepts.why:
“And it shall come to pass in the day that the Lord shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve”. This is speaking of the kingdom: the Lord gives us rest when we are delivered up out of here and we have the kingdom.

“That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon”: the king of Babylon is America. “and say, How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!” Taking up this proverb, we are saying, how was America destroyed? How was that golden city destroyed? America is the golden city because it is the richest country on this earth, and it is also called the oppressor.

When we read of the oppressor we think it is only speaking of oppressing the so-called negroes, the slaves here in America. No. America will oppress all nations, including Europe, and that is the time we are living in right now. For the last 70 years America acted as if it was about peace and justice and rights for everyone; now it is turning back into who it really is, the oppressor, and it is showing its true nature. That is the one sitting high, saying “Who shall bring me down to the ground?”

“How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder”. This Babylon is also America. The hammer of the whole earth is America, the oppressor: the country God used to beat all nations into subjection.

The same way the Lord used Nebuchadnezzar to judge Israel and to judge all the nations, America is the hammer, the oppressor, that is going to be used in these last days to bring judgment on all nations. That is why America will be “greatly despised”.

“Babylon hath been a golden cup in the Lord’s hand”. The Lord is the one using Babylon. America is a golden cup in the Lord’s hand: everything Babylon does is because the Lord wants it done, and everything Trump is doing on the earth today is because the Lord wants it done.

“that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunken of her wine”. That wine is oppression, affliction, falsehood, lies, deceit. It is the same cup the Lord told Jeremiah to let all nations drink of. America has that cup and is about to make all nations drink of it, and even if they do not want to drink, the Lord says, I am going to make you drink.

Take Venezuela: Trump went into a sovereign country, snatched up Maduro, brought the leader of that country back to America and is charging him on drug charges, and the Venezuelan government has been made to ship billions of dollars worth of oil to America. That is the cup. Venezuela will not be the only one to drink of it.

“therefore the nations are mad.” The nations are angry: Europe, China, Russia, Iran, the Arab nations, Venezuela, all nations on the earth. They have drunk of that cup, and in it is affliction and oppression. This is the beginning of sorrows. The world has changed and it is not going to get better, so we have to prepare our mind and our spirit and stop being caught up in sin. This is the end.

“And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast”: the ten horns are Europe, the EU. These shall hate her, and she is America. So according to the prophecy, Europe will hate America.

They “shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.” According to Bible prophecy, Europe is going to turn against America and burn America with fire: thermonuclear fire. When we see America wanting to take Greenland, NATO and Europe coming together and talking about war with America, and all the treaties and alliances between America and Europe starting to fall apart, that is prophecy being fulfilled.

“For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will”. God has put it in the European hearts. After America makes everybody drink of that cup, the nations will be angry: Europe, Russia, Iran, all nations. They will all hate America, turn against America and destroy America with thermonuclear destruction. That is the rising up against her in battle.

For some 70 years NATO, the North Atlantic alliance in which America basically protected Europe, held together. That alliance is done; it is falling apart. Europe is now speaking of a United States of Europe with a European army to back it: prophecy being fulfilled before our eyes.

sense.text:
Paul departed from Athens, came to Corinth, “And found a certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla; (because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome:)”. Rome commanded all the Israelites, all the Jews, to leave Rome. That is mass deportation.

The same thing Claudius Caesar did back then is what we see Trump doing today. The immigration raids are not raiding Europeans; it is the black and Hispanic communities they are going after. Aquila and Priscilla were deported from Rome under Claudius. That deportation only lasted a while, and afterwards the Jews were able to go back to Rome.

So do not be afraid of ICE and of what is going on with deportations. Everything that happens is of the Lord, and a man’s goings are of the Lord. Whatever happens to you, the Lord allowed it to happen. If they take away your green card or your citizenship and send you back to your country, it is what it is: it is of the Lord. Go over there and teach the word.

precepts.why: “And Paul after this tarried there yet a good while, and then took his leave of the brethren, and sailed thence into Syria, and with him Priscilla and Aquila”. What were Priscilla and Aquila doing after they were deported from Rome? They went forth evangelizing with Paul. They were doing the work, teaching the word of God in other regions, and that is how they met Paul.

“And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue: whom when Aquila and Priscilla had heard, they took him unto them, and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly.” This was Apollos. He knew only John, but he was teaching Christ, and Aquila and Priscilla brought him in and expounded to him the teachings of Christ more perfectly.

This brother and his wife were deported, and what were they doing? The work.

“Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus”, “Who have for my life laid down their own necks”. That brother and his wife were not regular: they put their own necks on the chopping block for Paul, and Paul called them his helpers.

They were deported from Rome, but the Lord had them set up to help Paul. It was a divine mission: they got deported, they went over there, they met Apollos, who was mighty in works and deeds, and taught him Christ more perfectly, and they helped Paul spread the gospel. That is why we should not be scared of ICE or go running scared. A man’s goings are of the Lord, and we must not let what we see on social media put fear on us.

“But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.” Every hair on our head is numbered, so do not live in fear and roll in fear.

If you are a believer in Christ and the spirit of Christ dwells in you, you are valuable, very valuable. Nothing can happen to you unless the Lord allows it.

“And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God”. If you love God, whatever happens, even the bad things in your life, happens for good. When Aquila and Priscilla were deported, that was for good, because they ended up as helpers in teaching the gospel. God had a plan for them.

“to them who are the called according to his purpose.” Every last one of us is called according to God’s purpose; God has a purpose for every last one of us. None of us knows where our going is, because a man’s goings are of the Lord, and we do not know what the Lord has planned for us in the future.

The brother France deported is one example: the French government told him to stop teaching the word of God and he could stay. He would not stop, so they labelled him an extremist, did not renew his papers, and kicked him out, though he had his green card. He is in Ghana now, doing good. Do not think papers, a green card or citizenship will save you: laws are being set up to take those things away from any who speak against America or against Christianity. Those not born here should start making preparation, just in case. And if ICE comes on you, do not run and do not cry. Have some dignity. Ask for a lawyer, plead the fifth, and have your documents prepared beforehand. The Most High has a plan and a purpose for you.

sense.text:
“Woe to the rebellious children, saith the Lord, that take counsel, but not of me”. We take counsel, but not of God.

“and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit”. The covering we cover ourselves with is politics. We cover ourselves with Christianity, worshipping white Jesus; we cover ourselves with being a Muslim; we cover ourselves with being Democrat. Everything but God’s spirit. And God’s spirit is the Holy Spirit: learning who you are and keeping the commandments and the faith of Christ.

“that they may add sin to sin”: that is what Christianity teaches. That is why the Christian church teaches against legalism and says you can do whatever you want, be a sinner, eat pork and shrimp, and Jesus is love. They add sin to sin.

“That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt!” This is not only speaking of back then; it is speaking of today. The shadow of Egypt is a place that looks just like Egypt but is not Egypt. The shadow of Egypt is America, and that is who we trust in. The same way we went down into Egypt and trusted in Egypt back then, we are doing the same thing today.

“Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame”. You came to America, you heard about the land of opportunity, you were sold the American dream, and now you are being rounded up and put in concentration camps and detention centers, and they are kicking down your door saying, we do not want you in our country. The strength of America has become your shame: you are locked up in federal detention saying, this was the American dream?

“and the trust in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.” Your trust in this system is now your confusion. You are wondering why these things are happening, when you thought America was about justice and rights.

“They were all ashamed of a people that could not profit them”. This is what our people are realizing today: America cannot profit you. “nor be an help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.” To be a reproach means you are hated.

“Wherefore thus saith the Holy One of Israel, Because ye despise this word, and trust in oppression”. As a people, we trust in oppression; we trust the oppressor. Everybody all over the world comes to America, the land of opportunity, but America was built on oppression. Isaiah 14:4 calls this place the oppressor.

How do we trust in oppression? We worship a God that does not look like us. The man that oppressed us and killed us, enslaved us and raped us, we follow after his God and think that is okay.

“and perverseness, and stay thereon”: and we stay in that perverseness. To trust in oppression is to worship the people that oppress you, follow them, and think they are going to help you and love you, and that the things they set up are there to help you. Even the oppressor says it: a white Christian preacher said this week that 90 to 95 percent of the black church in America is heretical, not even a true church, and that black people need to go and find a good white church to be taught. That is what Christianity is really about, and that is who our people trust in. Coming to America and trusting it as the land of opportunity is trusting in oppression, because this system was built on oppression.

“And though the Lord give you the bread of adversity, and the water of affliction”. Adversity is what our people are going through right now in these last days: doors being kicked down, our people put in detention centers, little babies, little kids. The water of affliction is our people crying, don’t separate me from my family, a wife and her children weeping as ICE agents take her husband. If those things do not boil you up inside, something is wrong with you, because those are your people.

“yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more, but thine eyes shall see thy teachers”. When these things happen, what we have to do is teach. Our people are crying, why are these things happening? I thought America was about rights and justice. It is our job to show them why. When our people are being afflicted, the teachers will not be pushed into a corner: they will see what is going on, be angry, and teach the word of God and show why these things are happening. And we have to go even harder. That is the reason God is making these things happen, because he opens their ears in affliction.

The teachers our people see are the men on the street in purple.

“And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it”. The teachers will be saying that all the things you have been following are a lie. This is the way; walk in it. Stop following Christianity, stop being a Muslim, stop following America, and get rid of that American dream.

“Ye shall defile also the covering of thy graven images of silver”: those silver crosses around your neck, you are going to throw them away. “and the ornament of thy molten images of gold”: those white Jesus pieces you be rocking, you are going to throw them away. “thou shalt cast them away as a menstruous cloth; thou shalt say unto it, Get thee hence.”

That is how our people are going to repent. They are going to say, we ain’t following Christianity no more; we ain’t following the white man’s religion. But for that to happen, we first have to be afflicted. That is why God is doing what he is doing. So when you get angry, go and teach and wake your people up. That is how you channel your anger.

“The burden of Egypt.” This Egypt is America. “Behold, the Lord rideth upon a swift cloud, and shall come into Egypt”: this is speaking of when Christ returns, not of the past. “and the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence”: that is Christianity. Christianity will be destroyed when Christ returns.

“And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians”: this is civil war. Before America is destroyed, civil war will take place here, and what we see taking place in America now is the beginning of sorrows that is going to lead up to it.

“and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour”: they are going to be fighting against each other here in America. “city against city”: America will be divided into different cities. “and kingdom against kingdom”: white men against white men, and Europe against America.

“And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord”. The one ruling during that time will be cruel. If we think Donald Trump is cruel, somebody else is coming who will be cruel as hell. And though it says a cruel lord, it is a whole system, not just one man: there is one man as a figurehead, like Trump today making decisions and talking all kinds of crap, but there is a whole system behind him.

“and a fierce king shall rule over them”: shall rule over America. Some will say that is Trump, but a lot of things have not happened yet. Trump is the beginning of it, the stepping stool to what is going to take place and create that civil war in the future.

To understand the civil war to come, we have to understand the past, because history repeats itself. The second amendment, the right to bear arms and to form a well regulated militia, was never written for us, who were enslaved at the time with no freedom of religion, speech or arms. It was written for white people, so that if a cruel lord, a tyrant, ever ruled over them, they could form a militia and rise up against their own government. The second amendment was set up for civil war, and the Lord had them put it in the constitution, because in the future he is going to send a cruel lord over them and they will fight and kill each other. The first Civil War began when America was divided and states seceded; today states like California speak of secession again.

“And the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron”. The fourth kingdom is Rome, and Europe and America are the extension of Rome. Strong as iron means strong militarily. “forasmuch as iron breaketh in pieces and subdueth all things”.

“the kingdom shall be divided”. That is what we see taking place right now: America is divided. “but there shall be in it of the strength of the iron”: they have that military strength, the same strength Rome had.
“so the kingdom shall be partly strong, and partly broken.” Militarily they are strong, and they are broken because they are divided.

precepts.why:
“Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against a house falleth.” We often use this for when we were divided in Jerusalem, but it is also speaking of the last days: the kingdom set up in the last days, and what is going to happen to it before its destruction.

“If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand?” Satan’s kingdom is Europe and America. America and Europe are divided and that alliance is falling apart, and here in America the citizens are divided. Satan is divided against himself, his kingdom is divided, and that is the sign they are about to fall.

sense.text: “Behold, the Lord rideth upon a swift cloud, and shall come into Egypt”: shall come into America. America is spiritually called Egypt.

“And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians”. That is what we see in the news right now, and the Lord is behind all of it: white people will be fighting white people. “city against city”: the same as in the past, when the southern states fought against the Union, the North. It is going to be the same thing again.

“And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord; and a fierce king shall rule over them”. That cruel lord and that fierce king is the leader and the government that will be set up in that time. Trump is a cruel lord, and he is the beginning of it, but he is not the one. When we see these things happening, it is the beginning of sorrows.

precepts.why:
“And it shall come to pass in the day that the Lord shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve”: the hard bondage we have been going through here in America.

“That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon”. The king of Babylon is that cruel lord, that fierce king read of in Isaiah 19. The king of Babylon is America. “How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!” America is the oppressor and the golden city. We think America has done evil things already; wait and see what America is going to do to these nations and to our people. Trump boasts of weapons nobody knows about, that shut everything down in Venezuela. He is about to bring heavy oppression on this earth.

“The Lord hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers”: they are also called the wicked, and the rulers are going to be destroyed. “He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke”: America is going to smite the people, all nations on the earth, in wrath, and what was done to Venezuela will be like nothing. It is going to be continual; we will see bad things keep happening and happening. “he that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted”: the nations will be ruled in anger and will be angry, as when Trump told the world economic forum, all we ask for is Greenland. And he is going to be persecuted.

It is not just about immigration and the detention centers; it is going to get worse and worse. So build your spirit up and prepare for when civil war comes. Gather together and prepare before that day. As we teach this word they are going to come after us, and they will kill some of us.

“Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial, because thou hast destroyed thy land, and slain thy people”. This land, America, is going to be destroyed, and they are going to kill their own people here. That is civil war: they will kill their own people the same way they did in the Civil War of the 1860s.

This goes back to the Lord setting a cruel lord over them, and Egyptians fighting against Egyptians. We saw it today: a white woman shot in the head and killed. ICE is like Trump’s personal military; it is not about immigration. It is there to create tension, so the protesters will do something. The king of Babylon has slain his own people, in civil war.

sense.text: “The violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon”. The violence done to us, the Israelites, is upon Babylon, and the Babylon here is America. The violence they are going to do to us, that blood is going to be upon them, because this is also violence they are going to do to us in the future. “shall the inhabitant of Zion say”: Zion is dwelling here.

“Therefore thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will plead thy cause, and take vengeance for thee”. As we pray and ask God for vengeance and for mercy, he is going to plead our cause and take vengeance on America for what they are doing to our people. So, brothers, though we are angry at what we see happening outside, the Lord said he is going to take vengeance for us. “and I will dry up her sea, and make her springs dry”: there will be no water here.
“And Babylon shall become heaps”: it is going to become a burnt heap. That is the prophecy.

precepts.why:
“Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, saith the Lord”. The land of the north is America. This shows it is not only speaking of the past, of what Nebuchadnezzar did to us; it is speaking of the future.

“Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.” The daughter of Babylon is Edom. So we, the Israelites, Zion, are dwelling with white people in the land of the north, in America. That is the inhabitant of Zion who says, the violence done to me be upon Babylon.

sense.text: “My people, go ye out of the midst of her, and deliver ye every man his soul from the fierce anger of the Lord.” How do you deliver your soul? You stop watching porn, stop committing fornication and adultery, stop worshipping the white image of Christ, stop being a Muslim, stop carrying grudges, hatred and envy. You serve God and get right. That is how you deliver your soul.

“And lest your heart faint, and ye fear for the rumour that shall be heard in the land”. The rumour heard in the land is war: civil war. Not just rumours of war in Russia or the Middle East, but rumours of America having a civil war, the rumours heard in the news today.

“a rumour shall both come one year, and after that in another year shall come a rumour”: one year you will hear there might be a civil war in America, and another year you will hear it again. “and violence in the land, ruler against ruler.” There will be violence here in the land of America. They will not only fight each other; they will kill us in this land too, those of us that teach the gospel.

“Therefore, behold, the days come, that I will do judgment upon the graven images of Babylon”: the graven images are Christianity. “and her whole land shall be confounded, and all her slain shall fall in the midst of her.” That is civil war taking place here in Babylon. It did not happen in ancient Babylon: ancient Babylon was not destroyed by violence like that, but by a coup.

precepts.why: “And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars”. The rumour is wars. So the rumour that shall be heard in the land of Jeremiah 51:46 is war in the land itself: civil war.

sense.text: “Woe to the world and them that dwell therein!” “For the sword and their destruction draweth nigh”. That is what we see taking place. “and one people shall stand up and fight against another, and swords in their hands.”

“For there shall be sedition among men, and invading one another”. Sedition is conduct or speech inciting people to rebel against the authority of a state or monarch: people rising up against their leader. Rebellion, revolt, insurrection, rioting. That is civil war, and that is what we are going to see. “they shall not regard their kings nor princes”.

“A man shall desire to go into a city, and shall not be able.” You will want to go into Texas and will not be able; you might want to go to California and cannot. Why? Because there will be seditions, civil war, and everybody is going to have to choose a side. The side we choose is the Lord’s side.

“For because of their pride the cities shall be troubled”: because of the white man’s pride, the city, America, will be troubled with civil war. “the houses shall be destroyed”: a lot of houses are going to be destroyed, so do not trust in the houses you have; they will be taken away too. “and men shall be afraid.”
“A man shall have no pity upon his neighbour, but shall destroy their houses with the sword”. That is civil war: destroying their houses through war, with the sword.

“Go your ways, and pour out the vials of the wrath of God upon the earth.” What is being poured out on the earth is the wrath of God: the seven angels have the seven last plagues, full of the wrath of God.

“And the fifth angel poured out his vial upon the seat of the beast”. The seat of the beast is America, as Revelation 17 explains. “and his kingdom was full of darkness”. That darkness is not only the sin, the adultery, fornication and wickedness. It is sedition, civil war, division, war and violence, and the saints being killed here too.

“and they gnawed their tongues for pain”: they bite their tongues for the pain. There will be a lot of pain here in the seat of the beast: sedition, civil unrest, civil war, their own citizens being killed.
“And blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, and repented not of their deeds.” Even with all that pain they still are not going to repent.

“And the great city was divided into three parts”. Remember what Christ said: every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation. “and the cities of the nations fell”: this is war.

“and great Babylon came in remembrance before God, to give unto her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.” Before God pours the fierceness of his wrath upon Babylon, the great city has to be divided first. Civil war has to take place here first; then God is going to destroy this place.

“And there fell upon men a great hail out of heaven, every stone about the weight of a talent”. That great hail is nuclear bombs, ballistic missiles, because they look like hail coming down from heaven. “and men blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail; for the plague thereof was exceeding great.” That is America being destroyed with thermonuclear destruction. Civil war is coming to this place, so prepare for what is coming.

precepts.why: “the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt.” That great city is America, spiritually Sodom and Egypt. So it is America that is divided into three parts before the cup of the fierceness of God’s wrath is given to her.
